scope.selected_candidate: Two unrolled static classical optical three-mode stages; four external input/output modes.
scope.mechanical_POC1: Separate candidate; its physical interpretation is not inherited.

definitions.PRB1-INVENTORY: This candidate certificate graph, not issued certificates.
definitions.PRB1-SOURCE-POC1: Pinned generic calibration/uncertainty boundaries; mechanical choices remain separate.
definitions.PRB1-DESIGN: Exact finite component and two-stage matrix design below.
definitions.PRB1-C-SYNTH: Exact synthesis and routing certificate specification.
definitions.PRB1-C-COMPONENT: Unconstrained measured component transfer certificate specification.
definitions.PRB1-C-PREPARE: Launched state, phase and dark-port preparation certificate specification.
definitions.PRB1-C-BUFFER: Separate finite-buffer to infinite-D3 prefix proof specification.

source_handles.boundary: Reuse provenance, disjoint validation and uncertainty requirements only; not mechanical F/V/SI identification.

finite_component.scope: New one-site component; not the five-site source or an asserted infinite-RRP1 prefix.

two_stage.map: U4=embed_(1,2,4)(O3)*embed_(1,2,3)(O3), using one-based indices; each embedding is identity on its unused coordinate.
two_stage.cold_input: A0=A1=0 ideally; actual classical dark-field bounds require a certificate.
two_stage.routing: Stage-1 state channels X1,Y1 physically propagate to stage 2 through declared delays; no intermediate measurement and remodulation. B0 never returns. Collect B0,B1 and final X2,Y2 only at terminal output planes.
two_stage.energy: U4^T*U4=I4 implies sum(input_i^2)/2=sum(output_i^2)/2 in the ideal model.

proposed_validation.interpretation: Fractions of launched model energy, not probabilities; physical preparation and E_star remain uncertified.

physical_mapping.interpretation: Real signed coordinates proposed as phase-referenced classical optical modal amplitudes.
physical_mapping.form: If independently calibrated, optical amplitude vector=sqrt(E_star/2)*z and signal energy=E_star*||z||^2/2.
physical_mapping.phase_rule: One fixed reference determines relative signs/phases across channels and trials; no per-output alignment to O3.
physical_mapping.quantum_boundary: No quantum-vacuum, photon-count or Born-probability assumption. Dark classical inputs have measured bounds, not asserted exact zeros.

design.matrix_names: raw_T3 acts on chi=(u,v,a), returning (v,w,b); O3=J3*raw_T3*J3^-1 acts on (X,Y,A). J3 is the declared energy factor, not the principal symmetric square root.

payload: Derive the one-site Dirichlet g=2 map from the pinned port law.
Prove the q,d energy identity, invertible J3 and O3=J3*raw_T3*J3^-1.
Verify O3 orthogonality/factorization and ordered U4 composition.
certificates.exclusion: No formal PASS, hardware or infinite-D3 claim.

payload: Exact ordered rotations, interconnections and all mode/phase labels.
State-link delays; fresh ports isolated, B0/B1 never return.
No intermediate measure/remodulate; actual parts/settings await readback.
Pinned POC1 independent calibration requirements specialized to optical I/Q modes: gain, phase/polarity, skew, bandwidth and loading.
Independent pulse-energy scale/integration standard.
Joint calibration region and standard/software/data provenance.
certificates.anti_circularity: Do not use desired O3/U4 to set readout gains, phase, timing or energy scale.

payload: Unconstrained measured complex transfers versus setting/band, including leakage/loss.
Spanning probes, phase superpositions, amplitude/linearity domain and estimator conditioning.
Measured link delay/dispersion, crosstalk, drift and joint uncertainty.
certificates.anti_circularity: Tune toward O3, but never constrain measured transfer to O3 or discard quadrature leakage.

payload: Target and independently measured launched four-mode state, pulse shape and reference phase.
Synchronization, unwanted-mode leakage and separate dark A0/A1 bounds.
Source/pair identity, amplitude range and drift; electronics zero is insufficient.
Complete input/output/loss/link and reservoir termination boundary.
Control/pump injection bounds; no hidden gain compensation.
Signal/LO energy separation and actual passivity in the declared norm.
Terminal detection/taps and their transfer effects.
certificates.memory_boundary: Terminal detection is not lossless optical storage; digital records and absorbed/exported optical energy are not two stores.

payload: Frozen disjoint preparations, settings and acquisition order.
Full complex four-mode response after two physical stages.
Independent input/final/reservoir/loss energy observations.
Joint error budget, fixed decision predicates and every invalid attempt.
certificates.scope: Tested classical component, modes, settings, amplitudes, band and two-stage horizon only.

payload: The accompanying note Section 1 supplies the general finite-propagation/buffer derivation; no formal status is assigned here.
A concrete full-RRP1 instance must still freeze its Dirichlet Lambda, source, ports and horizon satisfying that derivation.
Bind the finite positive energy form and explicit source/record transports to that same instance; no silent zero-mode quotient.
certificates.boundary: Not supplied by the one-site component and not required for its narrower transfer test.

payload: Physical K_c, context ownership and pointed-head preparation map.
Independent signed-source/ready/clock realization.
Explicit layer-gate admission; no optical write to U.
certificates.boundary: Laboratory preparation does not establish U-source embedding.

payload: Independent reservoir/pointer response, capacity, delay and energy boundary.
Full ordered raw/derived equality and q/ambiguity calibration.
Separate event, reset/domain and typed layer-gate rulings.
certificates.boundary: Energy/IQ outputs do not establish full RRP1 apparatus, signed-tape realization or Born occurrence.

dataset_partition.rule: Disjoint raw datasets across roles; shared standards retain joint uncertainty dependence.
dataset_partition.setup_scope: Characterize/tune components, preparation and bounded energy before validation freeze.
dataset_partition.heldout_scope: Freeze settings, extraction, source/phase/cut, model and budgets before validation acquisition or opening.

measurement_packet.hash_timing: Pin existing inputs first; hash future raw data at acquisition. No prehash of nonexistent data.
measurement_packet.invalid_rule: Retain every attempt; missing/clipped/mistimed data are invalid records, not zeros or silent omissions.

commuting_contract.ideal: For complete chi=(u,v,a), chi'=raw_T3*chi and J3*chi'=O3*J3*chi; the two-stage external four-mode map is U4.
commuting_contract.physical: Dec(P_phys(Enc(z)))=U4*z+r(z), with independently frozen Enc/Dec and bounded residual on a declared domain.
commuting_contract.exclusion: Intensity-only fits or target-dependent phase/readout do not compare complete signed states.

finite_horizon_error.scope: Two cold stages; norm is the independently calibrated full complex modal norm, including quadrature leakage.
finite_horizon_error.definitions: z_t=(X_t,Y_t) contains only the two memory coordinates; e_t=||actual_state-ideal_state|| is the error norm. Ideal cold norm<=R. L_t bounds actual decoded memory transfer, epsilon_t mismatch, nu_t dark/leakage/model contributions. Complete one-step chi also includes a.
finite_horizon_error.passivity_rule: L_t<=1 needs an independent bound in calibrated coordinates; physical optical passivity alone is insufficient. Otherwise retain the product.
finite_horizon_error.terminal_energy_bound: For ||ideal output||<=R and full-output error<=delta: absolute normalized energy error <= (2*R*delta+delta^2)/2. Multiply by E_star only with its joint calibration uncertainty.
finite_horizon_error.threshold_rule: Independent q/energy uncertainty required; resolve a crossing only if all admitted values give the same floor(heat/q), else retain ambiguity.
finite_horizon_error.no_probability: No Gaussian independence, L6 measure or Born frequency is inferred from these bounds.

decision_routing.missing_definition: STOP for missing required certificate/premise, circular calibration, changed context or incomplete budget.
decision_routing.invalid_acquisition: Retained INVALID packet under the frozen quality rule; not a scientific counterexample.
decision_routing.physical_rejection: With premises/integrity satisfied, an out-of-budget held-out response rejects only this realization/dictionary/domain.
decision_routing.physical_compatibility: Tested component/domain/horizon compatibility only; no exact universal, source, family or decoder closure.
decision_routing.administrative_checker: Future schema/hash/partition checks report administrative completeness, never physical certification.
decision_routing.canonical_boundary: No QDD owner status, Born target, occurrence, terminality, class completeness, SI derivation, mechanical POC1 contract or F3/production restriction changes.
